fields.description: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina is Select Group’s branded residential tower, with two- to five-bedroom homes, half-floor penthouses and multi-level Sky Mansions. Its four amenity levels bring shared leisure and wellness spaces into the building.

overview: The tower combines larger homes with four levels of shared facilities: Connectivity, Balance, Longevity and Horizon. Plans include spaces for work, exercise and relaxation rather than a conventional pool-and-gym offering.

Six Senses names Woods Bagot and Mitchell & Eades in the design story. The residences include half-floor homes and multi-level Sky Mansions; the selected contract defines the final fit-out and service package.
research.locationNote: Dubai Marina, Dubai. Views and the precise outlook depend on the selected residence; no guaranteed travel times or uninterrupted views are assumed.
research.priceNote: The branded factsheet advertised AED 5.8m for two-bedroom homes. Property Finder rounds its launch headline to AED 5.8m, with AED 5.76m in the body. These references do not establish current available stock or a unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The table follows the current developer FAQ. The earlier factsheet used 20% at registration, including an AED 100,000 reservation, then 20% within six months and 60% completion. Confirm the applicable signed schedule.
research.handoverNote: Select Group now states 2029 in both its project description and FAQ. Property Finder still states July/Q3 2028. The current developer target is used; actual delivery is unverified.
